## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Run the actual selected native coordinator launch path (ledger `dispatchTarget:
   subagent` — `run_subagent`/`subagent_general` on this harness) with a harmless
   stub worker; guard success causally required before launch and after the
   boundary/state transition; retain ordered calls, counts, versions, input
   identities; correct eligible first-new row dispatches exactly one stub.
2. Zero dispatch for: old GATE-G1 pointer, pending/failed prerequisite or CI,
   stale base/signature, skeleton, validation error, no-progress. Resume
   rechecks fresh state. Stub mutates no product and consumes no provider
   budget. Documentation-only or mocked-guard bypass is a failure.
3. REQ-H-008 ownership: resolve its literal predicate/aliases to numbered
   checks + actual evidence in the coverage register; record achieved D/E
   separately from owed R/P; no full-target claim.
4. Scoped verification; REQ ids stamped; operating clauses O-01–O-08.

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): actual native launch path + stub; causal guard
      ordering before launch and after boundary/state transition; ordered
      calls/counts/versions/input identities retained; exactly one stub for the
      eligible first-new row.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): each listed refusal proven without a spawn; resume
      rechecks fresh state; no product mutation / provider budget.
- [ ] AC-3 (D/E; ownership+evidence): REQ-H-008 predicate+aliases → numbered
      checks + register evidence; D/E vs owed R/P recorded.
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): regression fails without driver; exact
      commands + counts; docs/tooling checks.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal phase gate): green scope; REQ ids stamped; deferrals/
      ADRs; records agree; operating clauses.
